title.narrative: Governance Integration for Stabilization and Resilience (GISR)

description.narrative: (USAID Middle East Regional (MER)): .The primary objective of this line of effort is to sustainably strengthen local and national systems to adapt to shocks and stressors in the MENA region. Programming will support U.S. foreign policy objectives by promoting stable, democratic governance in the region through expanding USAID's knowledge base and tools by advancing analysis of governance, resilience, and stabilization needs. Programming, analysis, and training will include democracy and governance components and approaches such as engaging youth, civil society & media, marginalized groups, for example, religious and ethnic minorities, and formal/informal institutions to address instability. This is a centrally managed mechanism into which Missions can invest their bilateral funds. ..During FY 2022 this mechanism will program $75,000 to meet the Women, Peace and Security through earmark through potential pilot programming and research to support survivors of gender-based violence. Furthermore, pending receipt of funds we will look to partner with regional operating units to advance region specific analytics around women's participation in peace and conflict resolution. ..In addition, efforts will provide support for effective technical assistance in programming across the region on critical topics including Women, Peace, Security, Democracy, Stabilization, CVE, governance, civil society, anti-corruption, youth engagement and conflict prevention..
